decisions.headline: 《Hollow Knight: Silksong》免费扩展“Sea of Sorrow”定于12月11日推出
decisions.summary: Team Cherry在“Cherry Time! Special Presentation”中公布免费扩展“Sea of Sorrow”的上线日期。扩展将加入海洋主题的新区域、首领和工具，公开片段还出现了霍妮特钓鱼的画面。
decisions.verification: Famitsu与电ファミニコゲーマー两家独立媒体均确认12月11日日期；后者明确转述Team Cherry发布会，并列出新区域、首领和工具。
decisions.reason: 发布日期与核心内容由两家独立媒体交叉确认，具备明确的产品主体和日期增量。
decisions.timeNote: 仅确认2026年12月11日，未确认具体上线时刻。

PlayStation社区截图活动没有可纳入的产品事实增量，且缺少唯一主体。
与本期“Sea of Sorrow”主条目重复，未新增超出已采用事实边界的信息。

decisions.headline: 老虎机构筑魔法的Roguelite新作《SPELLOT》公开，计划2027年登陆PC
decisions.summary: 个人开发者soyukke公开《SPELLOT》的Steam页面。玩家通过停止三列转轮组合咒语部件，生成具有不同效果的魔法；作品计划于2027年内推出。
decisions.verification: AUTOMATON打开的报道明确转述开发者公开Steam页面及开发者帖子；发布日期仅到2027年内。
decisions.reason: 新作公开并给出独特玩法与平台窗口，信息增量完整。
decisions.timeNote: 仅确认计划于2027年内发售。

decisions.headline: Team Cherry公布星球探索新作《The Botanist and the Translator》
decisions.summary: 玩家将扮演植物学家Hatti，与翻译Oliver一同调查被黏稠花粉覆盖的星球，通过观察植物并与动物交流来解开生态谜团；作品面向PC开发。
decisions.verification: AUTOMATON打开的报道明确转述Team Cherry公布内容，并列出角色、设定与PC（Steam）平台。
decisions.reason: 新作公布，主体、核心玩法和平台均清楚。
与《The Botanist and the Translator》已纳入条目重复，未另立第二条。

decisions.titleEn: Blokkan: Secret of the Walking City
decisions.headline: Team Cherry Presents公布解谜冒险《Blokkan: Secret of the Walking City》
decisions.summary: Rohan Fraser开发的新作以一座巨型步行城市为舞台，调查员Abe Lightfoot与助手Momo将搜集线索、采访证人并追查案件；作品面向PC。
decisions.verification: Gematsu打开的报道转述Team Cherry Presents与Rohan Fraser公告及Steam页面概要。
decisions.reason: 新作公开，作品身份、玩法和平台均明确。

decisions.headline: Team Cherry Presents公布平台冒险新作《Radio Rain》
decisions.summary: Studio Stobie开发的《Radio Rain》描绘少女Cass被带到暴风雨笼罩的陌生世界，并与火焰精灵Ember结伴探索废墟、寻找归途；作品面向PC。
decisions.verification: Gematsu打开的报道转述Team Cherry Presents与Studio Stobie公告及Steam页面概要。
decisions.reason: 新作公开，作品身份、叙事前提和平台均明确。

decisions.headline: 《影之刃零》1.0304629版更新修复任务进度问题，并为日语专名加入振假名
decisions.summary: S-GAME计划于11月28日推送更新，修复可能阻断任务、道具获取与区域推进的问题，也调整武器和配饰的数值计算、输入反馈、性能与稳定性；日语设置下的专名将显示振假名。
decisions.verification: 4Gamer打开的报道明确转述S-GAME公告，并保留官方补丁说明中的版本号与修复范围。
decisions.reason: 正式补丁包含进度阻断、战斗数值与本地化改进，具有实质更新价值。
decisions.timeNote: 报道确认2026年11月28日推送；官方引文标注太平洋时间11月27日。

decisions.reason: 报道明确标注PR，主要是活动回顾与宣传汇总，缺少适合本期的独立事实增量。

decisions.headline: 传闻中的《The Simpsons: Hit & Run》重制项目可能已被取消
decisions.summary: VGC报道称，New Radical Games高级游戏设计师Darren Evenson在LinkedIn表示工作室一项未公布项目已被砍；报道结合此前页面素材和Matt Groening的含糊表态，推测该项目可能是重制版，但两者并未被正式绑定。
decisions.verification: VGC打开的报道确认开发者提到一个未公布项目被取消；该项目是否就是《The Simpsons: Hit & Run》重制版仍属媒体推测。
decisions.reason: 取消本身具有行业价值，但项目身份未获官方确认，按传闻边界发布并继续跟踪。
decisions.timeNote: 仅确认VGC于2026年11月27日报道，项目及取消时间未公开。

decisions.headline: 中古游戏店夜班恐怖游戏《Night Portable》定于12月21日发售
decisions.summary: Pumpkin Miso Studio确认PC版发售日。玩家将在2000年代的中古游戏店值夜班，同时躲避店内出现的怪异现象。
decisions.verification: 4Gamer打开的报道明确转述Pumpkin Miso Studio当日公告，确认作品身份、PC平台和12月21日日期。
decisions.reason: 发售日首次明确，作品主体与平台清楚。
decisions.timeNote: 仅确认2026年12月21日，未确认具体时刻。

decisions.headline: 校园推理冒险《男の娘裁判》在Steam推出试玩版
decisions.summary: Odd Games开始发布PC试玩版。玩家扮演暑期补习班教师，通过调查找出混入班级的“男の娘”。
decisions.verification: 4Gamer打开的报道明确转述Odd Games公告，确认试玩版已在Steam发布。
decisions.reason: 试玩版公开构成明确可验证的产品进展。
decisions.timeNote: 试玩版于2026年11月27日开始发布。

decisions.headline: 前GT世界系列赛选手参与《侠盗猎车手VI》车辆物理调校
decisions.summary: IGN报道称，曾参加《GT Sport》世界巡回赛的Lewis Bentley受雇于Rockstar车辆物理团队，约三年间参与车辆操控模型开发，并以物理部门开发者身份列入制作人员名单。

decisions.reason: 披露核心制作人员背景与开发分工，属于有实质增量的开发幕后信息。

entries.headline: Hollow Knight: Silksong Free Expansion Sea of Sorrow Launches December 11
entries.summary: Team Cherry announced the December 11 release date during its Cherry Time! Special Presentation. The free expansion adds sea-themed areas, bosses, and tools, while the footage also shows Hornet fishing.
entries.verification: Famitsu and Denfaminicogamer independently confirm the date; Denfaminicogamer explicitly relays the Team Cherry presentation and feature details.
entries.timeNote: Only the December 11, 2026 date is confirmed; no launch time was announced.

entries.headline: Slot-Built Spell Roguelite SPELLOT Announced for PC
entries.summary: Solo developer soyukke opened the Steam page for SPELLOT, in which stopping three reels combines spell parts into different attacks. The game is planned for release in 2027.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON relays the developer announcement, Steam page, and developer post.
entries.timeNote: The release window is limited to 2027.

entries.headline: Team Cherry Announces Planetary Exploration Game The Botanist and the Translator
entries.summary: Players take the role of botanist Hatti, joined by translator Oliver, to investigate a planet covered in sticky pollen by studying plants and speaking with animals. The game is in development for PC.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON relays the Team Cherry announcement and the PC platform.

entries.headline: Team Cherry Presents Announces Blokkan: Secret of the Walking City
entries.summary: Rohan Fraser’s puzzle adventure follows investigator Abe Lightfoot and assistant Momo as they gather clues and question witnesses across a gigantic walking city. It is in development for PC.
entries.verification: Gematsu relays the announcement by Team Cherry Presents and Rohan Fraser, together with the Steam overview.

entries.headline: Team Cherry Presents Announces Platform Adventure Radio Rain
entries.summary: Studio Stobie’s game follows Cass into a storm-covered world, where she frees the flame spirit Ember and explores ruined locations in search of a way home. It is in development for PC.
entries.verification: Gematsu relays the announcement by Team Cherry Presents and Studio Stobie, together with the Steam overview.

entries.headline: Phantom Blade Zero Patch 1.0304629 Fixes Progression Issues and Adds Japanese Furigana
entries.summary: S-GAME’s update fixes issues that could block quests, item acquisition, or area progression, and also addresses combat stat calculations, input feedback, performance, and stability. Japanese proper nouns gain furigana.
entries.verification: 4Gamer relays the S-GAME announcement and the official patch summary.
entries.timeNote: The report lists November 28, 2026 in Japan; the quoted official notice says November 27 Pacific Time.

entries.headline: Rumored The Simpsons: Hit & Run Remake May Have Been Canceled
entries.summary: VGC reports that New Radical Games senior designer Darren Evenson said an unannounced studio project was canceled. The report links it to earlier remake hints, but the canceled project was never officially identified as Hit & Run.
entries.verification: The developer statement confirms an unannounced cancellation; the connection to a Hit & Run remake remains VGC’s inference.
entries.timeNote: VGC reported the story on November 27, 2026; the project and cancellation date remain undisclosed.

entries.headline: Used-Game-Store Horror Title Night Portable Launches December 21
entries.summary: Pumpkin Miso Studio set the PC release date for its survival horror game about working the night shift at a used-game store while avoiding supernatural threats.
entries.verification: 4Gamer relays the developer announcement and confirms the PC platform and December 21 date.
entries.timeNote: Only the December 21, 2026 date is confirmed.

entries.headline: School Mystery Adventure Otokonoko Saiban Releases a Steam Demo
entries.summary: Odd Games has released a PC demo for its school mystery adventure, in which the player is a teacher investigating a summer remedial class.
entries.verification: 4Gamer relays the Odd Games announcement and confirms the Steam demo release.
entries.timeNote: The demo became available on November 27, 2026.

entries.headline: Former Gran Turismo World Series Competitor Helped Tune GTA VI Vehicle Physics
entries.summary: IGN reports that former GT Sport World Tour competitor Lewis Bentley joined Rockstar’s vehicle physics team, worked on the game for about three years, and appears in its credits as a physics developer.
entries.verification: IGN bases the report on Bentley’s since-deleted video and the game credits; no broader technical claims are inferred.
entries.timeNote: IGN published the report on November 27, 2026; exact employment dates were not disclosed.
